verdicts.reason: The filing does not have the capability any template role needs: the only relevant role, issuer in obl.material_event_current_report, needs listed_domestic_filer and would be Codelco, not the filing, and no document says Codelco is a listed domestic filer. No document says a listed instrument references the filing, or names a documented relation from it to an expressible entity; the find's expression block also gives no claim, entity or relation.

hops.note: The registry does not state a direction for binds. Still, the quote only says Codelco reported the stoppage in a filing and said it was 'committed to restoring operations', which is a report about the stoppage (closer to reports_on or evidences). It does not show the mine's supply binding the filing, or the filing binding any party to an obligation, in either direction.
